newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Hundreds of thousands head toward Rwanda - U.N.
newsitem.headline: Hundreds of thousands head toward Rwanda - U.N.

text.p: Hundreds of thousands of Rwandan refugees streamed through northwest Tanzania towards the Rwandan border on Saturday at the start of a mass repatriation, the U.N. refugee agency said.

"They are marching from Nyakahura onwards. They are all marching," said Judith Melby, a spokeswoman for the U.N. High Commissioner for Refugees. Asked if hundreds of thousands of refugees were heading for the Rwandan border, she said "yes".
Nyakahura is 90 km (55 miles) southeast of Benaco camp, the largest Rwandan refugee camp in Tanzania which is 17 km (10 miles) west of the Rwandan border with northwestern Tanzania.
"If you look at Rwanda, look at Zaire, you need something to unlock the jam. This (mass movement) is it," Melby added.
The exodus towards the border followed talks between camp leaders in Benaco and officials of the Tanzanian government, which says all 540,000 Rwandan refugees in Tanzania must leave by December 31.
